why: Spaces are legal in a path and quoted by the writer.
A colon-space and a space-hash end a bare YAML scalar; the writer quotes, so they must survive.
A double quote inside a double-quoted scalar must be escaped and read back as written.
A leading dash would read as a YAML block-list item when unquoted.
